text.p: These are the leading stories in the Egyptian press on Saturday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Egyptian President Hosni Mubarak opens the sixth annual economic conference of the ruling National Democratic Party. During the two-day conference, 15 committees will discuss 40 researches on market economy and national projects.
- The ministerial committee of privatisation will study tomorrow the offering of 10 percent of five shipping firms for sale to the public through the stock exchange.
- Mubarak to receive Ukrainian Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko. During the three-day visit, the two countries will sign five agreements on trade and investment cooperation.

- Italian Foreign Trade Augusto Fantozzi will arrive in Cairo on Tuesday, atop of an economic delegation of businessmen and representatives of the Italian industries federation. The delegation will discuss means of cementing economic and trade ties between the two countries and the Egyptian-European association agreement.
- Ukrainian Prime Minister Pavlo Lazarenko hails the ties between Egypt and his country, saying "our relations are excellent and we seek to achieve special association agreement with Egypt".
